tasks.label: Upload to Saturn
tasks.command: usbreset "FT245R USB FIFO" && sleep 2 && ftx -x ./cd/data/0.bin 0x06004000 && sleep 1

args: usbreset.cmd 'FT245R USB FIFO'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; & ftx.exe '-x' './cd/data/0.bin' '0x06004000'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

osx.command: usbreset 0x0403:0x6001 || echo 'usbreset failed (may need sudo); continuing'; sleep 2; ftx -x ./cd/data/0.bin 0x06004000 && sleep 1

tasks.label: Start FTX
tasks.command: if pgrep -f "^ftx -g" > /dev/null && ! (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/1234) 2>/dev/null; then pkill -9 -f "^ftx -g"; sleep 0.5; fi; if ! pgrep -f "^ftx -g" > /dev/null; then nohup ftx -g 1234 -v > /tmp/ftx.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; timeout 8 gdb-multiarch -batch -ex "target remote localhost:1234" -ex "detach" -ex "quit" ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf > /dev/null 2>&1; fi

args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1234 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $listener) { Start-Process -FilePath 'ftx.exe' -ArgumentList '-g','1234','-v' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; & gdb-multiarch.exe '-batch' '-ex' 'target remote localhost:1234' '-ex' 'detach' '-ex' 'quit' './BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }

osx.command: if pgrep -f "^ftx -g" >/dev/null && ! nc -z localhost 1234 >/dev/null 2>&1; then pkill -9 -f "^ftx -g"; sleep 0.5; fi; if ! pgrep -f "^ftx -g" >/dev/null; then nohup ftx -g 1234 -v > /tmp/ftx.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; perl -e 'alarm 8; exec @ARGV' gdb-multiarch -batch -ex "target remote localhost:1234" -ex "detach" -ex "quit" ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf >/dev/null 2>&1; fi

tasks.label: Connect to GDB
tasks.command: if pgrep -f "^ftx -g" > /dev/null && ! (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/1234) 2>/dev/null; then pkill -9 -f "^ftx -g"; sleep 0.5; fi; if ! pgrep -f "^ftx -g" > /dev/null; then nohup ftx -g 1234 -v > /tmp/ftx.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; timeout 8 gdb-multiarch -batch -ex "target remote localhost:1234" -ex "detach" -ex "quit" ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf > /dev/null 2>&1; fi && gdb-multiarch ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf -ex "target remote localhost:1234"

args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1234 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $listener) { Start-Process -FilePath 'ftx.exe' -ArgumentList '-g','1234','-v' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; & gdb-multiarch.exe '-batch' '-ex' 'target remote localhost:1234' '-ex' 'detach' '-ex' 'quit' './BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; & gdb-multiarch.exe './BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf' '-ex' 'target remote localhost:1234'

osx.command: if pgrep -f "^ftx -g" >/dev/null && ! nc -z localhost 1234 >/dev/null 2>&1; then pkill -9 -f "^ftx -g"; sleep 0.5; fi; if ! pgrep -f "^ftx -g" >/dev/null; then nohup ftx -g 1234 -v > /tmp/ftx.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; perl -e 'alarm 8; exec @ARGV' gdb-multiarch -batch -ex "target remote localhost:1234" -ex "detach" -ex "quit" ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ; gdb-multiarch ./BuildDrop/Debug_GDBStub.elf -ex "target remote localhost:1234"
